location_exception_reason: Prefabricated isolation wards are manufactured structures with standardised specifications (panel material, HVAC, negative pressure capability) that function identically regardless of installation location. Buyer decision factors are technical (HEPA filtration, fire rating, installation speed) and regulatory (healthcare compliance), not geographic origin. Location in title is redundant.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Prefabricated Isolation Ward Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product description. The product meaning is unchanged.
